title: Whole-night five-stage sleep scoring

titles: Sleep-EDF Expanded: Sleep Cassette development scope

scientific_question: Can EEG identify five sleep stages in people excluded from fitting without using their hypnograms to trim the recording?
primary_outputs: Five probabilities for every eligible fixed 30-second epoch.

data_manifest.declared_subset: 153 Sleep Cassette recording nights from 78 participants, corroborated by the official MNE age_records.csv mapping; exclude the 44 Sleep Telemetry recordings from this first scope.

example_labels.validation: Downloaded the 4,620-byte annotation file only; SHA256 matches publisher and EDF+ labels/onsets/durations are present.

recording_contract.neural: Representative EDF header: EEG Fpz-Cz and EEG Pz-Oz at 100 Hz; horizontal EOG 100 Hz. Respiration, submental EMG, temperature and Event marker are 1 Hz in this file; channel rates must be read per asset.
recording_contract.labels: Actual EDF+ annotation file contains Sleep stage W,1,2,3,4,R,? with onset/duration. Merge 3+4 to N3 for a five-class task; mask unscored/movement intervals evaluator-side under an explicit policy.
recording_contract.time_alignment: Signal and annotation header start date/time agree (24 April 1989,16:13:00); EDF+ onset/duration labels align to the signal clock. First wake annotation spans 0–30,630 seconds; fixed 30-second epochs must use the recording clock.
recording_contract.biological_ids: 78 Sleep Cassette people, multiple recording nights per person; MNE age_records.csv provides participant/night/asset mapping. Group all nights of one person in a split.
recording_contract.evidence: Actual 2,048-byte EDF header and complete 4,620-byte hypnogram inspected; no EEG sample payload downloaded.

missing_or_unverified: No exact input asset record was extracted from the linked readiness manifest; inspect the pinned source audit before acquisition.

biological_unit: 78 Sleep Cassette people, multiple recording nights per person; MNE age_records.csv provides participant/night/asset mapping. Group all nights of one person in a split.
case_definition: One isolated biological-unit/session packet under the split policy; multiple scored observations are nested items, not independent biological cases.

split.policy: All nights for one person in one outer partition; full-clock epochs and fixed context; fit frequency features/scalers/thresholds on training people only.
split.uncertainty: Biological-unit paired uncertainty where multiple units exist; single-animal/person tasks use descriptive session/trial blocks and do not imply population replication.

common_policy.fixed_program: Freeze program and fitting/adaptation recipe before query access; any target-batch adaptation must be explicitly permitted.
common_policy.case_adaptive: Same allowed data, checkpoint tools, context batch and accounted compute; no evaluator labels/feedback; reset case state as specified.
common_policy.model_tools: Compare generic numerical tools, supplied decoder alone, and matched agent-plus-decoder arms. Record checkpoint training exposure and preparation cost.
common_policy.investigation: Require estimand, numeric artifacts, uncertainty, alternative explanations and executable evidence; independent scorer verifies them.

observable_endpoints.definition: Participant-macro macro-F1, with per-stage recall and full-night confusion matrices.

evaluation.comparability: Task variants and related outcomes share source/family evidence. Never sum task counts as independent cohorts or average unlike native metrics.

resources.basis: Planning estimate only; reuse author processed inputs first. Training/runtime/storage not measured for this task.

source_storage_evidence.observed_total_archive_size: 8.1 GB uncompressed according to publisher; includes Sleep Telemetry outside the proposed first scope.
source_storage_evidence.bounded_intake_plan: Two participant nights for schema/loader checks, then a person-grouped development panel; do not select nights or people based on reference performance.
source_storage_evidence.compute_estimate: CPU-oriented bandpower plus random forest; runtime/RAM not measured, and entire archive need not be loaded simultaneously.
